description: This file contains utility functions for configuration evaluation, runtime environment checks, and binary existence verification in a Node.js environment.

methods.name: isTruthy
methods.description: Determines if a value is considered truthy based on its type and content.

methods.name: resolveConfigPath
methods.description: Resolves a nested configuration value given a dot-separated path string.

methods.name: isConfigPathTruthyWithDefaults
methods.description: Checks if a configuration path is truthy, falling back to defaults if undefined.

methods.name: evaluateRuntimeRequires
methods.description: Evaluates if runtime requirements are satisfied based on available binaries, environment variables, and config paths.

methods.name: evaluateRuntimeEligibility
methods.description: Determines if the current runtime environment meets specified OS, platform, and requirement conditions.

methods.name: hasBinary
methods.description: Checks if a specified binary exists in the system's PATH.
